method: Each definition in s17-mutation-defs.json applied alone by exact text replacement, its whole test file run with the vitest JSON reporter, every touched file restored and compared by SHA-256, then the whole file rerun. A proof needs the named row to fail on an AssertionError, no other row of its group to fail (for a Gate 3 group row; a standalone test's other failures are recorded), a byte-identical restore and an all-passing rerun. Integration tests run on local PostgreSQL with the real schema built from the migrations, as envoi_web for the routes and envoi_maintenance for the runner, with DATABASE_URL removed; Solana RPC is a FIXTURE faked at the bounded transport, wallets are key pairs made in the run, PayPal is the FIXTURE fake at the PayPalWriteClient boundary, and every signature, history page and landed transaction is synthetic. The grant definitions only widen a grant in migration 0023, with no code change, so each proves the grant itself is the barrier; two definitions change a migration constraint beside the code because the database independently refuses the mutated write.
